item.title: A Decade of Stories, A Future of Empathy: Roshan Abbas on 10 Years of Spoken Fest
item.description: For an industry that thrives on spectacle, scale, and star power, building a festival around words was once considered—by his own admission—“madness.” A decade later, that madness has shaped India’s live storytelling culture into a full-blown movement. item.title: Anime India Kolkata 2026 Draws Strong Brand Participation with DOMS Industries’ Experiential Showcase
item.description: DOMS Industries Limited showcased its latest art and writing innovations at Anime India Kolkata 2026, engaging young creators through an interactive and experiential platform.

item.title: NODWIN Gaming Sells Entire EVO Stake to RTS, Refocuses on Emerging Markets
item.description: NODWIN Gaming has sold its entire stake in EVO to RTS, marking a strategic portfolio realignment as the company strengthens its focus on emerging markets and reports a return to EBITDA-positive growth.

item.title: Mumbai Indians and BookMyShow Live Launch ‘The MIX’ Fan Festival in Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai Indians and BookMyShow Live have launched The MIX, a two-day experiential festival blending cricket, music and culture, set to take place on March 21–22 at Jio World Garden, Mumbai.

item.title: Team Innovation Expands to North America, Targets 50+ Annual Shows
item.description: Team Innovation has launched North America operations under Team Innovation International, aiming to host over 50 shows annually and produce the regional leg of Anuv Jain’s Dastakhat Tour in 2026.

item.title: Shakira Returns to India for Feeding India Concert 2026 in Mumbai & Delhi
item.description: Shakira will headline the Feeding India Concert 2026 in Mumbai and Delhi, marking the initiative’s first multi-city edition aimed at advancing the Zero Hunger mission.

item.title: Karnataka Tourism Society Hosts CONNECT 2026 Stakeholder Meet in Bengaluru
item.description: The Karnataka Tourism Society, in partnership with the state government, hosted CONNECT 2026 in Bengaluru, outlining investment targets and reinforcing PPP-driven growth under the Tourism Policy 2024–29.

item.title: Rashi Entertainment Hosts ‘आनन्दम FEST 2026’ for Delhi Government in Greater Kailash
item.description: Rashi Entertainment will host आनन्दम FEST 2026 on behalf of the Delhi Government, bringing music, fitness and community celebrations to Greater Kailash on February 21–22.

item.title: JBC Kabaddi League to Launch in 2026 with Five Teams
item.description: The Kabaddi Associations of Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh have sanctioned the JBC Kabaddi League, set to debut in 2026 with five teams and Randhir Singh Sehrawat as Brand Ambassador.

item.title: Gateway of India Lights Up for India-France Year of Innovation 2026 with Public Video Mapping Show Until February 22
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Emmanuel Macron launched the India-France Year of Innovation 2026 at the Gateway of India, accompanied by a public video mapping show running through February 22.
